audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart says Skill on five of seven rows while every paragraph under it says Zaahen wins those rows: whys[1] 'At level 2 you spike', whys[2] 'At level 3 you dominate', whys[3] 'Levels 4-5 stay yours', whys[4] 'At 6 it's even', whys[5] 'your sustain and tankiness beat his lethality poke'. The packet levelChart reads Skill/Zaahen/Zaahen/Zaahen/Skill/Zaahen/Zaahen — identical to the prose.
audit.why: Full and content agree with each other but both disagree with the packet and with their own explanatory text, so the page shows a neutral chart above paragraphs claiming a dominant lane.
audit.corrected: Five rows flipped as matched full+content pairs: Level 2, Level 3 and Levels 4-5 to Zaahen; Level 6 to Skill (the row the prose calls even); First item to Zaahen. 2+ items already reads Zaahen.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike is described as Zaahen's row while the prose calls it even, and no cooldown is attached to either ultimate.
audit.why: Comeuppance is 100/85/70s. Naming the 100-second rank-1 cooldown turns 'his R changes the math' into a window the player can count.
audit.corrected: Level 6 row set to Skill in both layers; spikes[1].text now carries the 100-second cooldown and the real reason the ult is survivable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. (1) Comeuppance is described as 'a channel you can interrupt or LoS' — Riot's text says nothing about interruptibility, but it DOES say the stored bullets damage 'the first champion, minion, or structure hit'. The real, verifiable answer is body-blocking with your own wave, and that is nowhere on the page. (2) Going Rogue is never mentioned at all: it is camouflage on an 18/14/10/6/2s cooldown and Zaahen has no reveal in his kit, so wards and a sweeper are mandatory.
audit.why: Telling a player to interrupt a channel this file cannot confirm is interruptible is a guess; telling him to stand behind a caster minion is written into Riot's own description. And a top laner who never buys a sweeper against a camouflage champion gets picked in his own sidelane.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and whys[4] rebuilt around the first-target-hit rule; Going Rogue and the Control Ward requirement added to breakdown.cooldowns, report[10].t, late and wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Swing is named as the tracked cooldown fourteen times without ever stating its length or its terrain requirement.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s — one of the longest escapes in the lane — and Riot's text says it hooks into terrain and that he is knocked off it when colliding with champions or terrain. That is why walking him down works.
audit.corrected: 15s at rank 3 and the collision rule written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: wants.you[1] 'Denying him a wall to Heroic Swing off of' is confirmed by Riot's text (the hook fires into terrain) and is already correct — kept.

edits.before: At 6 it's even — Comeuppance adds burst but it's an interruptible channel you can cut.
edits.after: At 6 it's even — Comeuppance adds burst but the first minion hit eats the shot.

edits.before: His R Comeuppance is a burst execute but it's a channel you can interrupt or LoS. You still hold the edge because your R Final Retribution locks him out of the E swing escape he relies on.
edits.after: His R Comeuppance stores bullets, then hits only the first champion, minion or structure in the line — stand behind your wave and it lands on a caster. Then punish the 100-second cooldown.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 are firmly yours: out-range his poke with Q, gap-close with E on his cooldowns, and punish the fact he can't peel a walking juggernaut. At 6 stays green — his R is interruptible and your R kills his swing escape.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 are firmly yours: out-range his poke with Q, gap-close with E on his cooldowns, and punish the fact he can't peel a walking juggernaut. At 6, Comeuppance only hits the first target — hold a minion between you.

edits.before: On items Akshan turns to lethality burst and roams, but you out-sustain the 1v1 and out-pressure the sidelane; deny walls, punch his shield, and take towers when he leaves.
edits.after: On items Akshan turns to lethality burst and roams, but you out-sustain the 1v1 and out-pressure the sidelane; deny walls, sweep his camouflage, and take towers when he roams.

edits.before: Roaming to revive teammates instead of dueling you
edits.after: Camouflaged roams to revive instead of dueling you

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing (15s at rank 3): it needs terrain, and colliding with a champion knocks him off it. - Going Rogue: camouflage, so a Control Ward is not optional. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Your CC / setup is premium gank assistance — ping your jungler when Heroic Swing is down. Ward river before extended trades.
edits.after: Your CC / setup is premium gank assistance — ping your jungler when Heroic Swing is down. Sweep the bushes — Going Rogue is camouflage.

notes: Five chart rows flip here; they are proposed as matched full+content pairs and belong to one atomic group. The 'interruptible channel' claim about Comeuppance was removed rather than reworded — the kit file cannot confirm interruptibility and needsResearch is empty by design, so it stays unverified. Zaahen's own ability names again disagree with the mirror (Golden Onslaught / Ominous Return here, Aureate Rush / Dreaded Return in the mirror audit); left untouched.
